answer: Concretely, the economy can threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The beacon of work and the horizon of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a crystal to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
